g.text: One browser app, two Appwrite Functions and one TablesDB database. The same pure code runs in the browser and on the server.
the API key never reaches it
Appwrite Cloud (Free plan: 2 Functions, no cron)
Families, organisers and the public use the same app; what each can read is decided by TablesDB row permissions and Teams, and every
write goes through a Function that re-checks the caller.
